title: Point partition by the prescribed cyclic constant-extension sheets
statement: For a finite-field datum D of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], m >= 1, and a separated finite-type k_0-scheme X_0, let h_i be the actual maps constantExtensionCyclicSheet D m hm X_0 i of [def-zl-constant-extension-cyclic-sheet]. Their ranges are pairwise disjoint and their union is the entire underlying space of the geometric fibre of the original-base constant-extension model. No immersion, coordinate-isomorphism, tensor or Frobenius-normalization clause is asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-zl-constant-extension-sheet-tensor-splitting] to E = k_m. The evaluation ring equivalence takes t tensor b to (sigma(t)b)_sigma. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-finite-product-fields] its spectrum is a disjoint union of m copies of Spec k. Base-changing along X_0 gives a disjoint point covering of Y by component ranges. The affine pullback identification [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] expresses the component morphism as a tensor t tensor b mapping to a tensor sigma(t)b. Its idempotents come from the constant factor, so the descriptions agree on affine overlaps.

Let gamma be inverse q-Frobenius of [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. On the component maps the tensor formula gives j_sigma followed by H = g followed by j_(gamma^-1 sigma). The prescribed cyclic map h_i therefore has the range of j_(gamma^-i|E); precomposing by g^i leaves its range unchanged. Each embedding E into k lands in E because it preserves the roots of T^(q^m)-T, whose set in k is exactly E. The powers of q-Frobenius enumerate these embeddings by [lem-sfb-finite-field-galois-frobenius], so the m ranges h_i are exactly the components of the preceding disjoint covering. This proves pairwise disjointness and the asserted union. For m=1 the family has one component; for empty X_0 every range is empty and the ambient space is empty.

lean.statement:
theorem constantExtensionCyclicSheetPartition :
    Pairwise (fun i j : Fin m ↦ Disjoint
      (Set.range (constantExtensionCyclicSheet D m hm X₀ i))
      (Set.range (constantExtensionCyclicSheet D m hm X₀ j))) ∧
    (⋃ i : Fin m, Set.range (constantExtensionCyclicSheet D m hm X₀ i)) = Set.univ
